out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: Observed hand sink in dish washing area with wiping cloths, spray bottle, storage basket in basin.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. All items removed from basin. EHS educated CFM that all hand sinks must be accessible for use at all times.

out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: observed cooked beef stored on shelf below raw chicken, observed raw chicken filling on shelf above jelly in WIC.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. Cooked beef moved to shelf with other RTE foods. Raw pork filling moved to shelf not above RTE. CFM discussed with staff proper storage order of foods in unit.

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: cooked pork at 61F, marinated cooked egg at 60F, bok choy at 58F in #4 ATOSA 2 Dr prep.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. All food in unit discarded. CFM discovered unit was unplugged. Employee replugged unit and will not store any food in unit until back at proper cold holding temperature of 41F or below.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control: cooked boba.
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours, is used as the public health control the food shall: 1) have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature OR 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 2) be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 3) be cooked and served, served if ready-to-eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 4) be discarded if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit. CFM had employee mark boba with 4 hour end point of ~3:00PM. EHS will email TPHC form to CFM to complete.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Disclosure
violations.observation: The following raw and/or undercooked foods are provided on the menu, menu board, table tent or brochure without proper disclosure: marinated egg for ramen dishes.
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a disclosure statement that includes a description of the animal-derived foods as raw/undercooked or identification of the animal-derived foods by asterisking (*) them to a footnote that states that the items are served raw or undercooked, or contain raw or undercooked ingredients. EHS recommended creating table tent so that undercooked marinated egg is directly linked with ramen dishes only.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name. Observed spray bottles with sanitizer with no identifying name.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. CFM will have employee label all spray bottles with sanitizer name.

out_items.name: Food properly labeled, original container

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: various containers of spices at cookline.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. CFM will have employee label containers with food name.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter. Observed wet wiping cloths at bar stored on countertop.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. EHS instructed CFM to keep all wet wiping cloths in sanitizer solution when not in use.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed gaps to exterior of building along back exit door.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. CFM stated work order has been placed to install weather stripping and/or close gaps at back exit door.

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: Upon discussion with the person-in-charge, one or more of the elements of an effective employee health policy is either missing or incomplete. A complete employee health policy is required to be in place at the food establishment. At the time of this inspection, the Health Department provided and reviewed handouts and resource information in a red folder labeled 'Employee Health Policy.' OBSERVED NO EMPLOYEE HEALTH POLICY IN PLACE.
violations.corrective_action: A complete employee health policy must have the following elements: 1) Employee training on foodborne illness, particularly symptoms of illness and prevention of the Big Six illnesses (see 'What is Foodborne Illness' handout); and 2) Documentation that employees have been instructed of their responsibility to report symptoms of, diagnosis of or exposure to foodborne illness to management (see 'Employee Illness Reporting Agreement' handout); and 3) A management plan to restrict or exclude employees, as applicable, who have symptoms, diagnosis or exposure to foodborne illness (see 'Employee Illness Decision Guide for PIC/CFM' handout). The information provided at the time of this inspection will help you develop and implement this policy. Handouts are available in the following languages: English, Arabic, Chinese (traditional), Farsi, Hindi, Korean, Spanish, Thai, Urdu and Vietnamese. If you have any questions about your employee health policy, please contact your area inspector or contact the Health Department at 703-246-2201, TTY 703-591-6435. EHS PROVIDED EMPLOYEE HEATLH POLICY TO CFM. UGLY DUMPLING (Inspection Date: 11/03/2025) Page 2 of 4

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events. OBSERVED NO WRITTEN PROCEDURE FOR CLEAN UP OF VOMIT AND DIARRHEA.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. EHS PROVIDED WRITTEN PROCEDURE FOR CLEANUP OF VOMIT AND DIARRHEA TO CFM. CFM WILL ORDER BODILY FLUID CLEAN UP KIT.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the BAR BEING USED A DUMP SINK. SIEVE WITH FRUIT SEEDS OBSERVED IN BAR HAND SINK.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. EHS REVIEWED WITH CFM THAT HAND SINKS MUST ONLY BE USED FOR HAND WASHING. BAR AREA HAS 2 DUMP SINKS.

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: The handwashing sink NEXT TO DUMPLING CHEST FREEZER WAS OBSERVED AT 69-74F.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. EHS RECOMMENDED CFM CONTACT PLUMBER TO ADJUST VALVE OR ISSUE MAY BE DUE TO 4TH WATER HEATER BEIND DISCONNECTED. EHS WILL FOLLOW UP ON OR AROUND 10 DAYS.

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: HALF AND HALF IN #1 OBSERVED AT 49F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CFM DISCARDED HALF AND HALF.

out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Cooling in Equipment
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: OBSERVED DOUBLE NESTING OF CONTAINERS IN #6.
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. EHS DISCUSSED WITH CFMS THAT CONTAINERS SHOULD NOT BE DOUBLE NESTED TO ENSURE MAXIMUM CONTACT WITH COLD AIR IN UNIT.

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Equip/Utensils Self-Draining Position/Covered/Inverted
violations.observation: OBSERVED PLASTIC STORAGE CONTAINERS WET NESTING IN DISH AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Clean equipment and utensils shall be stored covered or inverted to prevent contamination. CFM WILL DISCUSS WITH DISH STAFF PROPER DRYING OF CONTAINERS BEFORE STORAGE.

out_items.name: Hot and cold water available, adequate pressure

violations.title: Hot Water Capacity to Meet Peak Demands
violations.observation: OBSERVED 2 OF 4 WATER HEATERS ON. CFM TURNED 3RD WATER HEATER ON. 4TH WATER HEATER HAS BEEN DISCONNECTED BY PLUMBER.
violations.corrective_action: APPROVED PLANS INCLUDED 4 WATER HEATERS INSTALLED IN TANDEM. ANY MODIFICATIONS TO THE EXISTING WATER HEATER SET-UP MUST BE SUBMITTED AND APPROVED TO THE HEALTH DEPARTMENT PRIOR TO ANY WORK BEING COMPLETED. RECONNECT/REINSTALL 4TH WATER HEATER - SUBMIT PLANS TO HEALTH DEPARTMENT VIA PLUS SYSTEM FOR PLAN REVIEW BEFORE STARTING ANY WORK. EHS WILL FOLLOW UP WITH CFM ON STATUS OF ORDERING REPLACEMENT WATER HEATER.

out_items.name: Toilet facilities properly constructed, supplied, and cleaned

violations.title: Covered Receptacle in Women's Toilet
violations.observation: There is no covered refuse container for the disposal of feminine napkins in the ladies room stall.
violations.corrective_action: A toilet room used by females shall be provided with a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins.

out_items.name: Hands clean and properly washed

violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee failed to wash his or her hands before engaging in food preparation, after touching bare human body parts, after coughing, sneezing, eating, after handling soiled utensils, or after engaging in any activity that could contaminate the hands. A food employee was observed drinking water from personal cup and did not wash hands afterwards.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. Employees instructed to wash hands after each change of tasks, including when eating/drinking.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: Hand sinks in facility observed providing water around 85 deg F.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet.

out_items.name: In-use utensils properly stored

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: plastic bowl used to scoop rice observed place on top of rice in the warmer.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. Bowl was removed. A rice scoop to be used, instead.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Manual Wash Water Temperature
violations.observation: The temperature of the in-use wash water solution was observed at less than 110F. Water at 3 compartment sink observed at 85 degrees F.
violations.corrective_action: The temperature of the wash solution for manual warewashing machine must be no less than 110F or the temperature specified on the cleaning agent manufacturer's label instructions. EHS to follow up within 10 days to verify that hot water at 3 compartment sink may reach minimum of 110 degrees F.

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a BLEACH test kit for the dish machine and QUATERNARY AMMONIA test kit for the 3 compartment sink. Provide verification that both have been obtained within 10 days.

out_items.name: Hot and cold water available, adequate pressure

violations.title: Hot Water Capacity to Meet Peak Demands
violations.observation: The water heater / boiler serving the food service establishment is no longer operable. The facility has 4 tankless hot water heaters — 2 were observed not in operation. The PIC attempted the 2 hot water heaters on, and both failed.
violations.corrective_action: Hot water generation and distribution systems shall be sufficient to meet the peak hot water demands throughout the food establishment. At this time, a new commercial, approved water heater shall be installed to meet the peak hot water demands. The water heater shall be approved prior to installation. Alternatively, repairs may be obtained on the two inoperable hot water heaters. The EHS to follow up within 10 days to verify the repair of the hot water heaters, or to verify if new hot water heaters are required.
